title: hyperdoctrine
description: A functor P : C^op → Lat from a base category of contexts to fibers of propositions (Lawvere). Reindexing P(f) along a substitution f has adjoints ∃_f ⊣ f* ⊣ ∀_f — the quantifiers are adjoint functors. The corpus's predicate-category is the instance with fibers in the bilattice FOUR (a MALL-algebra), settling = least fixpoint of a fiber-wise nucleus. A functor refined to carry fibered logical structure.

base.description: the base category C of contexts/entities

fibers.description: for each context, a lattice of propositions — in this corpus the bilattice FOUR as a MALL-algebra

reindexing.description: substitution f* : P(d) → P(c) along f : c → d, contravariantly functorial

quantifier-adjoints.description: ∃_f ⊣ f* ⊣ ∀_f, with the Beck–Chevalley condition (witnessing is compositional)
